Title: Relates to judicial diversion programs; repealer
Summary: Relates to judicial diversion programs; establishes a diversion part in each county; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.
LawCode: Rpld §216.00 sub 1 ¶¶(a) & (b), cl ¶, amd CP L, generally; amd §212, Judy L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the criminal procedure law and the judiciary law, in relation to judicial diversion programs; and to repeal certain provisions of the criminal procedure law relating thereto
